title: Input Read After One Step
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input word, let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$, and let $d\in\mathbb{Z}$. Write $f(e)$ for the input symbol seen from $c$ at offset $e$, and let $\rho$ record the input and work-tape symbols read in $c$. If $c$ is halted, the input read after one step at offset $d$ is $f(d)$. If $c$ is active, let $m$ be the input-head movement prescribed by $M$ from its state and reads $\rho$. The read after one step is $f(d)$ when the input read in $\rho$ is absent and $f(m)$ is also absent; in every other case it is $f(d+m)$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
